```{r}
#| label: setup
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
source(file.path("..", "Figure_Data", "FigureABM.R"))

R0_VALUES <- c(5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17)
MATRICES  <- c(POLYMOD = "../scenarios", "Epistorm-Mix" = ".")

fmt <- function(x) formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
```

```{r}
#| label: data
sizes <- rbindlist(lapply(names(MATRICES), function(m) {
  rbindlist(lapply(R0_VALUES, function(r0) {
    s <- abm_summaries(MATRICES[[m]], r0, epistorm = m == "Epistorm-Mix")
    s$final[,
      .(
        median = median(outbreak_size),
        q25    = quantile(outbreak_size, 0.25, names = FALSE),
        q75    = quantile(outbreak_size, 0.75, names = FALSE)
      ),
      by = scenario
    ][s$runs, on = "scenario"][, `:=`(matrix = m, r0 = r0)]
  }))
}))
sizes[, matrix := factor(matrix, names(MATRICES))]
```

The three focal scenarios of Figure 4 for R0 = 5, 7, ..., 17 with the Epistorm-Mix contact matrix (`make sensitivity_epistorm`), against the same scenarios with the POLYMOD matrix of the main analysis (`make scenarios`, in `scenarios/`). Each scenario has 1,000 runs; runs with fewer than `r MIN_OUTBREAK_SIZE` cases are excluded as early extinctions. As in Figure 4, self-isolation with quarantine uses the run with quarantine and the other two scenarios the run without.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-epistorm
sizes[, cell := sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fmt(median), fmt(q25), fmt(q75))]

tab <- dcast(
  sizes,
  r0 + scenario ~ matrix,
  value.var = c("retained", "cell")
)
setorder(tab, r0, scenario)

kable(
  tab[, .(
    r0, scenario,
    retained_POLYMOD, cell_POLYMOD,
    `retained_Epistorm-Mix`, `cell_Epistorm-Mix`
  )],
  col.names = c(
    "R0", "Scenario",
    "Retained runs, POLYMOD", "Infections, POLYMOD",
    "Retained runs, Epistorm-Mix", "Infections, Epistorm-Mix"
  ),
  align     = "rlrrrr",
  caption   = paste(
    "Final outbreak size at day 365, median (interquartile range) across",
    "the retained runs, by contact matrix."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-epistorm
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: "Final outbreak size at day 365 by R0 and contact matrix: median and interquartile range across the retained runs."
ggplot(sizes, aes(r0, median, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), size = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~matrix, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = SCENARIO_COLORS) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = R0_VALUES) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "R0", y = "Infections") +
  theme_figure4() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = INK_PRIMARY))
```
